title: Evaluator contract suite on synthetic golden data
description:
Contract suite of synthetic golden inputs and outputs, owned by the evaluator rather than by any corpus packet.

Cases: canonical identity matching; label and classification; per-layer eligibility including every reasoned outcome; closed-world scope; one-to-one assignment; duplicate findings; zero-positive reviewed scopes; path normalization and rejection of absolute, traversing and malformed paths.

This is the regression guard for the migration. The existing Jest fixture cases cannot serve that role — they encode the implementation being replaced, and will stay green through most of this work.
